scope: Cleanup ordering regression; six selected synthetic photographs, 24 previously frozen synthetic photographs, 22 regular Hunodan inputs with frozen crops, and six actual browser uploads plus an ROI check. Real photographs are not new unseen evaluations.
timingLimitations: Unrelated headless Firefox jobs were observed consuming CPU during the preceding 24-photo replay. Repeated timings and the earlier Hunodan timing failure are retained; wall-clock variation prevents a strict isolated speed comparison.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.
